CA.rationale: Content (red) and a processing-origin (command_estimate/feedback) are explicitly linked for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red), its organization/access metadata (origin), and the separate status distinction are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing-related origin tags (command_estimate, history_estimate, feedback_through) explicitly link content-processing conditions/changes to specific content referents.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content mentions (red/blue coordinate sets) identify content and attribute.

D.rationale: Content identity (red set) is presented separately from organization/access metadata (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/represented_time/kind fields describe how content is organized/accessed/derived.
